verdict.rationale: Auth0's first-party docs list passkeys, WebAuthn biometrics, and email/SMS passwordless as login methods, and describe one-time codes delivered by email or SMS. The evidence never mentions magic links, and all support is vendor marketing or overview text. missing for 10: explicit magic-link sign-in documentation, in-depth passkey/passwordless configuration docs, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can offer passkeys/WebAuthn and passwordless options like magic links or email OTP as first-class sign-in methods

citations.quote: supports a wide range of login methods, including username/password, social IDs, enterprise SSO, email/sms passwordless, biometrics via WebAuthN and Passkeys
you want your users to log in with one-time codes delivered by email or SMS
Embrace a passwordless world with passkeys
With passkeys, your credentials are securely stored and synced in the cloud, ensuring you can easily move between devices.
